{{Quote|Might survive it more if I give you up. Who knows where they're going to throw us? The Pinnacle? Jubilar? Whatever pit they find, they’re not going to let us forget what we've done.|[[Tasia]]|<ref name="Tempest Runner" />}}
'''Jubilar''' was an astronomical object<ref name="COTR" /> in the [[Jubilar system]] in the [[Jubilar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]], in grid square T-7 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was used as a [[prison]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], it was one of several locations where a majority of Separatist [[prisoner]]s were sent.<ref name="COTR" /> During the [[Imperial Era]], the prison came under the control of the [[Galactic Empire]] and was turned into a [[factory|penal work camp]], where convicts were tasked with manufacturing the toes for [[All Terrain Scout Transport]]s.<ref name="Rise" /> Jubilar remained a prison after the [[New Republic Era|rise]] of the [[New Republic]], which incarcerated [[Borbin Todds]] there to serve a twenty-five-[[Standard year|year]] sentence for harboring a wanted fugitive.<ref name="Chapter 14" />
